title: AliExpress Winning Products Scraper — Input
description: Configure which categories/keywords to scrape and how deep to go.

searchQueries.title: Search keywords
searchQueries.description: List of keywords to search on AliExpress (e.g. 'wireless earbuds', 'LED strip lights').

categoryUrls.title: Category URLs
categoryUrls.description: Direct AliExpress category URLs to scrape (e.g. https://www.aliexpress.com/category/202003560/phones.html).

maxProductsPerQuery.title: Max products per category/query
maxProductsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of products to scrape per search query or category (max 1000).

sortBy.title: Sort products by
sortBy.description: Criteria used to rank/sort products when scraping listings.
enumTitles: Orders (last 7 days) — Best for winning products

scrapeReviews.title: Scrape reviews
scrapeReviews.description: If enabled, fetches the most recent product reviews (slower).

maxReviewsPerProduct.title: Max reviews per product
maxReviewsPerProduct.description: Maximum number of reviews to scrape per product (if scrapeReviews is enabled).

scrapeVariants.title: Scrape product variants
scrapeVariants.description: If enabled, fetches all variants (color, size, etc.) with their individual prices.

minOrders.title: Minimum orders filter
minOrders.description: Skip products with fewer orders than this value (0 = no filter). Useful to identify winning products.

minRating.title: Minimum rating filter
minRating.description: Skip products with a rating below this value (0 = no filter).

country.title: Target country
country.description: Country code for pricing and shipping info (affects prices shown).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify proxy (recommended — AliExpress blocks datacenter IPs).

requestDelay.title: Delay between requests (ms)
requestDelay.description: Milliseconds to wait between requests to avoid rate limiting. Minimum 500ms recommended.
